chain_of_causes.cause: kernel generated a random module signing key and a time-stamped certificate on every build
chain_of_causes.fix: install the checked-in keys/module-signing.pem and point CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_KEY at it

chain_of_causes.cause: DW_AT_comp_dir embedded the absolute build path, and the linker build id hashes the whole vmlinux including debug sections
chain_of_causes.fix: -ffile-prefix-map for the repository and work directory

chain_of_causes.cause: assembly keeps its own line table and .S files build from KBUILD_AFLAGS, not KBUILD_CFLAGS
the 32-bit compat vDSO builds from its own VDSO_CFLAGS/VDSO_AFLAGS and never saw the maps; its build id is embedded in .rodata and then hashed again by the vmlinux build id
chain_of_causes.fix: the same maps in KCPPFLAGS_COMPAT, the variable that Makefile documents for user-supplied flags

method: two full builds from one lock, fresh work/ and out/ each time
method_notes: the build id was left intact; the debug information was made deterministic rather than the id being pinned
clang applies the last matching prefix map, so the narrower work path is listed after the repository path
with CONFIG_DEBUG_INFO_COMPRESSED_ZSTD the compressed debug sections avalanche, so byte counts from cmp on the compressed vmlinux are not a reproducibility measure; decompress first
